intro: Welcome to Metropolis, an ancient city in İzmir province, from the 3rd century BC. It sits on a slope above the Torbalı plain, and it is known for its council house, its theatre and a bath-gymnasium built to serve two thousand people.
history: The city was founded in the Hellenistic period on a slope above the Torbalı plain, and it grew under Rome. Since the 1990s, excavations have uncovered its council house, its theatre and a bath-gymnasium built to serve two thousand people.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the bouleuterion, the theatre, the bath-gymnasium and the stoa.
facts: Did you know? The name means 'city of the mother goddess': Metropolis was the centre of the cult of Meter Gallesia. And its bath-gymnasium was built to serve two thousand people at once.
outro: This brings our tour of Metropolis to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Thank you for listening, and enjoy your visit.
